seeds.vh-1-2-0-0: At the damp limestone arch, Elder Corin checks the hemp seal of your chosen Guild line against the biting gales.
seeds.vh-1-2-0-1: In the shadowed mule yard, Biscuit tests the oiled canvas hitch while Master Hesketh inspects your bronze load.
seeds.vh-1-2-1-0: Beside the frost-rimed horse trough, Miller Bran offers salted barley bread before you cross the ridge.
seeds.vh-1-2-1-1: Under the creaking sign of the Nine Knots, Sola weaves a spare splice into your harness straps.
seeds.vh-1-2-1-2: Near the winch-house wall, a cable-lord named Garrow measures your packs with greedy, calculating eyes.
seeds.vh-1-2-1-3: Behind the drying rack of sheepskins, young Marta thrusts an extra pair of tallow mittens into your pocket.
seeds.vh-1-2-1-4: At the outer buttress, a pair of fog-wardens warns you of loose shale blocking the lower stone-cut.
seeds.vh-1-2-1-5: Over the high stone stile, the grey monastery wall ends and the sheer vertical drop begins.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-0: On the narrow ice-shelf above the mule track, a stray pebble rattles down into the white abyss.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-1: Within the drafty salt-porch, Kaelen the cooper points out a hairline fracture in your wooden cradle frame.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-2: By the frozen sheep-fold, an old drover named Orvyn warns of sudden updrafts lifting heavy burdens.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-3: Under the swinging iron lantern of the guard-post, Joran demands your toll-token with a gruff nod.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-4: Against the cliff face, the wind hums a thin chord through the bronze Clapper on your aching back.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-5: Past the frozen fountain, a nervous apprentice drops his tallow bucket down the deep stone chimney.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-6: At the narrow switchback known as Devil's Knee, Biscuit plants all four hooves against the ice.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-7: Inside the damp salt-store, weaver Jessa hands over a spare hemp length before you cross the ridge.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-8: Beneath the dripping icicles of the high conduit, a rook bursts from the masonry with a harsh cry.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-9: On the exposed limestone shelf, flying sleet stings your cheeks as you steady the shifting Clapper.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-10: Beside the collapsed retaining wall, mason Toval stacks wet slate to mend the crumbling pathway.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-11: Through the swirling white squall, the distant bronze bell-tower of Vesperhold chimes a muffled noon.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-12: At the rope-slack turn, a frayed guide-line whips across your knuckles like a cold iron wire.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-13: Within the sheltered niche of St. Jude's shrine, a tallow candle guttered out moments before your arrival.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-14: Over the frozen rill, your left boot slips on black ice, throwing the heavy bronze load askew.
seeds.vh-1-2-2-15: Near the abandoned lime kiln, local gatherer Ruda offers hot pine tea from a battered tin flask.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-0: At the upper winch station, operator Brimm checks the tension wheel while the heavy cable hums.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-1: Across the mossy gully, a cluster of icicles snaps and clatters down the cliff face.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-2: Within the stone shelter, Toll-clerk Nesta counts copper coins by the flickering light of fat-lamp.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-3: Beside the frozen water-butt, mule-driver Korda strokes Biscuit's twitching ears to calm the beast.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-4: Under the granite overhang, an old shepherd named Daveth whittles a replacement peg for his pack frame.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-5: On the steep slate stairs, your thighs burn with every downward step under the crushing bronze weight.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-6: Past the rusted iron crane, the valley mist rolls upward like a grey woolen blanket.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-7: At the crossroads of the three winds, a painted signpost points toward the lower stair-towns.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-8: Within the alcove of the weathered boundary stone, someone has left a fresh sprig of dried rosemary.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-9: Beside the sheer drop of the Ninety Steps, a loose handrail swings wildly in the mountain gust.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-10: Under the low lintel of the guard-shelter, a sleeping sentinel jerks awake as your boots crunch.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-11: On the frosted wooden landing, a flock of mountain jackdaws scatters into the grey gloom.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-12: Near the salt-encrusted cistern, cooper Thram patches a leaking barrel with fresh birch hoops.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-13: Across the dizzying wire bridge, the first tier of the rope-market hangs above the abyss.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-14: Within the shadow of the buttress, weaver Milla checks her knotted tally-cord against the rising wind.
seeds.vh-1-2-3-15: At the turn of the stone stair, a discarded leather mitten lies frozen stiff in the rime.
seeds.vh-1-2-4-0: On the broad stone landing above the lower gate, merchant Vane weighs bundles of dried chicory.
seeds.vh-1-2-4-1: Beneath the wooden awning of the toll-house, a clerk stamps travel permits with frozen red ink.
seeds.vh-1-2-4-2: Beside the tethering ring, Biscuit shakes the frost from his grey coat while you adjust the harness.
seeds.vh-1-2-4-3: Through the gap in the stone parapet, the first cluster of rope-market stalls shimmers in the mist.
seeds.vh-1-2-4-4: At the head of the lower stair, guard Captain Selby inspects your monastery seal with tired eyes.
seeds.vh-1-2-4-5: Inside the drafty wool-shed, sorter Elva combs burrs from a fleece while listening for your approach.
seeds.vh-1-2-4-6: Over the wooden footbridge, the rhythmic thrum of distant water-mills vibrates through the damp air.
seeds.vh-1-2-4-7: Against the cliff-side notice board, a fresh parchment decree flaps violently in the rising gales.
seeds.vh-1-2-5-0: At the threshold of the rope market, the smell of Stockholm tar and wet hemp fills your lungs.
seeds.vh-1-2-5-1: Under the timber archway, a line of laden pack-mules waits for the barrier bell to ring.
seeds.vh-1-2-5-2: Beside the central winch-drum, master rigger Joran signals the clearance for the descent to Lowgate.
seeds.vh-1-2-5-3: Out past the outermost winch-house, the endless grey tiers of the rope-town drop into the cloud sea.
seeds.vh-d-1-2: Ignoring the ice-warning on the upper stair, you rush the descent in the gathering squall until the frozen cradle slips and pitches the Clapper into the abyss.
